decision: rule
evidence: Inventory scope of the India TB Reports (§5.1, §4 item 5, §7.4). (1) Figures of the named quantities, and other ACF figures as `other:`, enter when their sentence, list item or table (title, column heading or row label), or the heading of their chapter, section or box, names active case finding (ACF) or the TB Mukt Bharat Abhiyaan campaign, or when the section describes a TB campaign that lists ACF among its activities (§5.1 covers any ACF or campaign figure; review ruling of 19 November 2026). (2) Resources and targets enter only when their own sentence or table row names ACF or the campaign (campaign documents' rule 3). (3) A figure for a district, block, city or project population is not entered: the §5.2 geography field takes India or a State/UT. (4) The State notification counts of the 2024 edition enter because §7.4 enters and classifies them; the notification annexures of the 2020 and 2023 editions are outcome data only (not ACF or campaign figures, not named in §7.4). (4a) The India TB Report 2020 has no §5.3 basis (it is not marked include = yes in data/search_log.csv, is not cited by an included document as the source of a figure, and is not Question 3477): none of its figures enters the inventory; its tables stay in data/extracted (Q3 may use its ACF annexure as a published table, §8). (5) Media, IEC, nutrition-support and Ni-kshay Mitra campaigns are not TB case-finding campaigns; their figures are programme-wide and not entered. (6) Benchmark thresholds of the ACF guidance are not entered (ruling A20). (7) Pictures of social-media posts reproduced as illustrations are not figures published by the report and are not entered.
